policy: Use exactly one canonical diagnosis code from the predicted category. Codes name the primary root cause, not a downstream symptom. Do not invent aliases.

expression: Expression-like text lacks the leading equals sign required to evaluate it.
Expression refers to a node name that does not exist in the supplied workflow.
Expression reads a property path that does not match the supplied JSON input.
Expression calls a method unavailable for the receiver or uses incorrect method casing.
Expression has invalid syntax, such as a missing operand or delimiter.
Native Date methods are confused with n8n's Luxon DateTime expression API.
data_mapping: Required property can be absent or null and needs an evidence-supported fallback.
Selected array index does not correspond to the requested item.
Supplied value type differs from the explicit downstream or API type requirement.
Logical OR replaces valid falsy values such as zero; nullish coalescing is required.
Text such as false is treated as truthy rather than parsed explicitly.
Mapping path does not match the nested structure in the supplied JSON.
item_linking: The .item reference cannot resolve one upstream item because multiple items are possible.
Transformed output items lack pairedItem metadata needed for downstream source-item linking.
First or last selects the wrong item based on the explicit ordering and requirement.
first() selects one item when the workflow requires all returned items.
Expression names the wrong upstream node although the intended node exists.
No reliable pairedItem lineage or stable join key is supplied; do not guess.
node_configuration: Configured HTTP method contradicts the explicit endpoint contract.
Body data is configured but sendBody is disabled.
Response format conflicts with the downstream data requirement.
Timeout option has an invalid type or representation.
Timeout is shorter than an explicit service response-time requirement.
Wait node duration differs from the explicitly requested delay.
workflow_structure: Connection points to a node name not present in the workflow.
IF node true and false output targets are swapped.
A required source branch is not connected to its Merge node input.
Existing downstream node is unreachable because a required edge is absent.
Connection references an output index invalid for the source node.
code_node: Run Once for All Items returns one object instead of an array of output items.
Code node output items do not wrap their data inside a json property.
Configured Code node execution mode conflicts with the APIs and output shape used by the script.
Script references a variable not declared or available in the current item context.
Code node returns primitive values instead of n8n item objects.
Transformation changes item lineage but omits the required pairedItem references.
execution_api: API confirms a retryable rate limit but the node lacks explicitly supported bounded retry settings.
API identifies a missing or incorrect request key present in the supplied input.
API contract specifies a required value type that differs from the request value.
Remote 5xx outage is evidenced without a safe workflow-only correction.
DNS or connection failure is evidenced without proof of a workflow parameter fault.
Explicit service timing requirement exceeds the configured request timeout.
credentials: Provider rejects configured authentication; credential owner must verify it.
Authenticated identity lacks required provider permission or scope.
Credentialed operation has no selected credential reference.
Provider reports expired OAuth authorization requiring owner reauthorization.
Provider rejects or reports an unavailable API key; model must not guess a replacement.
Required secret is redacted or unavailable, so no safe secret-related patch is possible.

abstention_rules: All credentials category cases require patch=[] and needs_human_review=true.
Do not patch a provider outage or DNS/network failure without evidence of a workflow-side cause.
Do not guess an item selection when paired-item lineage or a stable join key is missing.
Never modify credentials or secret values.
